name: Integer Cube compute format
work_unit: integer MACs (not floating FLOPs); baseline float MAC count identical

cases.purpose: A substantial bounded integer dot may benefit from integer Cube arithmetic and less conversion.
cases.hypothesis: A substantial bounded integer dot may benefit from integer Cube arithmetic and less conversion.

cases.purpose: A tiny matrix may be launch/conversion dominated and expose integer accumulator overhead.
cases.hypothesis: A tiny matrix may be launch/conversion dominated and expose integer accumulator overhead.

cases.purpose: Longer K may benefit from the integer compute format while remaining exactly representable.
cases.hypothesis: Longer K may benefit from the integer compute format while remaining exactly representable.

cases.purpose: A second tiny geometry may show no throughput benefit and retain format/conversion costs.
cases.hypothesis: A second tiny geometry may show no throughput benefit and retain format/conversion costs.
